Data Engineer-Data Platforms-Databricks
description:
Your role and responsibilities As a Data Engineer specializing in Data Platforms-Databricks, you will play a critical role in building and enhancing the Databricks platform for client's Data and AI use cases. This role involves implementing Data and AI use cases on the Databricks platform, requiring strong technical expertise and collaboration. Your primary responsibilities will include: Implement Data and AI use cases: Implement data and AI use cases on the Databricks platform, ensuring seamless integration and optimal performance. Enhance Databricks Platform: Build and enhance the Databricks platform to meet client needs, leveraging expertise in data engineering and cloud technologies. Support Client Use Cases: Collaborate with clients to understand their data and AI requirements, providing technical expertise to implement use cases on the Databricks platform. Required education Bachelor's Degree Preferred education Master's Degree Required technical and professional expertise Databricks Platform Expertise: Experience with building and enhancing Databricks platforms for data and AI use cases, including implementing data and AI solutions. Data Engineering Skills: Experience with data engineering principles and practices, including data processing, storage, and retrieval on cloud-based platforms. Cloud Technology Knowledge: Experience with cloud technologies, including migration, deployment, and management of data and AI applications on cloud-based infrastructure. Implementation Expertise: Experience with implementing data and AI use cases on Databricks platforms, ensuring seamless integration and optimal performance. Technical Collaboration: Experience working collaboratively with clients to understand their data and AI requirements, providing technical expertise to implement use cases on the Databricks platform. Preferred technical and professional experience Cloud Migration Knowledge: Exposure to migrating data and AI applications to cloud-based infrastructure, including deployment and management on Databricks platforms. Advanced Data Engineering: Exposure to advanced data engineering principles and practices, including data processing, storage, and retrieval on cloud-based platforms. AI Solution Implementation: Exposure to implementing AI solutions on Databricks platforms, ensuring seamless integration and optimal performance. Years of Experience: 
7 - 9
